gloss: somehow; one way or another; barely

definitions.gloss: somehow; one way or another; barely manage to
definitions.explanation: indicates that something was accomplished with difficulty or through some means

examples.japanese: どうにか⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I somehow made it in time.

examples.japanese: どうにか⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to solve it somehow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どうにか⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
- どうにか + verb: somehow managed to do
- どうにか⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ + verb: wanting/trying to do something somehow
- どうにか⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: things will work out somehow
Implies difficulty or uncertainty in achieving the result. Often used for situations where success was achieved narrowly or against expectations.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ - somehow (similar, slightly more common)
- かろうじて - barely, narrowly
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧ - finally, at last

CONTRAST WITH どうにも:
- どうにか - positive outcome (somehow succeeded)
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - negative outcome (can't do anything about it)
